newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Achmea seals takeover of Prudential unit.
newsitem.headline: Achmea seals takeover of Prudential unit.

text.p: Unlisted Dutch financial services firm Achmea Group said on Friday it had finalised the takeover of the Dutch life insurance operations of British insurer Prudential Corp Plc.
The takeover of Prudential Leven NV, which was first announced in July, will substantially strengthen Achmea's market position, it said in a statement.
The unit will continue to operate as an independent subsidiary but the brand name Prudential will disappear from the Dutch market.
Prudential said last month the Dutch unit accounted for annual premium income of 95 million stg and added that the sale would have no material effect on its net assets.
No further financial details of the transaction were disclosed.
